description: HP-06 serves as the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Rampur Bushahr subdivision in the Shimla district. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and overseeing transport regulations in this key mountainous region located along the National Highway 5.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Rampur Bushahr, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
